title: Data privacy and model safety test method for longitudinal federal learning

pse.problem: The lack of access to training data labels and server models in vertical federated learning creates challenges for backdoor attacks.
pse.solution_function: Implement label inference attacks and backdoor attacks to test the privacy and model security of vertical federated learning algorithms and defense methods.
pse.solution_structure: Not explicitly stated, but involves participants with local data and a centralized server.
pse.solution_implementation: Label inference is performed to obtain target data label information. Triggers are constructed to implant backdoors into the black box model on the server.
pse.effect: Provides a new tool for testing the privacy protection and model security capabilities of vertical federated learning algorithms and corresponding defense methods.
